name: Butler County, OH
findings: Butler County has 1,105 nonprofit organizations. 461 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 359 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Butler County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few health care organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 6 health care organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 17 would.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 107 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
